_comment: Windows-only local Copilot hook registration. Every command explicitly invokes PowerShell 7; Copilot coding-agent cloud hook execution is unsupported. agentStop firing remains unverified, so boy-scout-check queues advisory findings for the observed userPromptSubmitted delivery leg. boy-scout-check never blocks. Exactly one userPromptSubmitted hook composes routing, plan-gate, security salience, and any queued Boy Scout nudge. The per-tool matcher is intentionally omitted because Copilot write-tool names vary; guard.ps1 self-filters by path and content. See docs/enforcement-surfaces.md for the capability matrix.
